0022600106.text: The 76ers, who are 2-0 and first in the Atlantic, host the 0-2 Milwaukee Bucks, who are fifth in the Central and 13th in the East, in Philadelphia's third game of the season. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the 76ers won the 2025-26 season series 4-0, most recently taking a 126-106 regular-season win in Philadelphia on April 12, 2026. Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back, fracture), and Tacko Fall (quadriceps, strain) are out for the 76ers, while Dean Wade (ankle, sprain) and LeBron James (back) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions.
